一九七一年五月二十九日，北京医学院大礼堂。

早晨七点多，大礼堂门口已经站满了人。灰蓝色的中山装、草绿色的军装、藏青色的工装，各色衣服在晨光中汇成一片。今天不是上课，是开表彰大会。消息前几天就传开了——恭王府挖出来的那批宝藏，立功了。一等功。

王建新来得早。他穿着一身四个兜的干部军装，帽子端端正正地扣在头上，武装带扎得紧紧的，皮鞋擦得能照见人影。他站在礼堂门口的台阶下面，看着陆续赶来的人群，脸上没什么表情。旁边站着医疗系七班的其他三十三个人，一个个穿得整整齐齐，胸前的红五星在阳光下闪着光。

八点整，大礼堂的门开了。人群鱼贯而入，按照指定区域坐好。大礼堂能坐五六百人，今天坐得满满当当的。前面几排是学院党政领导和军队派驻干部，中间是教职工代表，后面是全体工农兵学员，两边还坐着一些从校外来的嘉宾。最前排靠边的位置，坐着两个普通的中年人——男人穿着一件洗得干干净净的蓝布中山装，女人穿着一件藏青色的褂子，头发梳得整整齐齐。是王建新的父亲和母亲。

昨天部队来人，通报今天开表彰大会，并邀请父母参加。母亲连夜把父亲那件中山装烫了又烫，用搪瓷缸装上热水，在衣服上来回熨，把褶子烫得平平整整。

大会还没有正式开始，台上的灯光已经全亮了。主席台上方悬挂着巨幅伟人画像，两侧拉着红色的横幅——“弘扬爱国奉献精神，表彰国家宝藏守护功臣”。台下的座位一排排的，整整齐齐，像部队的队列。扩音器里放着《东方红》的旋律，低低的，像是背景音。

八点半，学院党委书记、军队派驻首长、革委会主任等领导依次走上主席台，在铺着红布的长桌后面坐下来。党委书记姓李，五十来岁，头发花白，戴着一副黑框眼镜，穿一身灰色的中山装。军队派驻首长姓孙，是军代表，四十出头，穿一身军装，腰板挺得笔直。

孙军代表走到话筒前，清了清嗓子。

“同志们，北京医学院工农兵学员军医表彰大会，现在开始！全体起立，奏唱国歌！”

扩音器里响起《义勇军进行曲》的前奏。全场五六百人齐刷刷地站起来，王建新也站起来，腰板挺直，目视前方。他的父母也跟着站了起来，父亲站的姿势有点僵硬，母亲有些手足无措，不知道该把手放在哪里，看见旁边的人都把手垂在裤缝上，也跟着照做。

国歌奏完了，孙军代表宣布请坐。椅子响了一阵，大家坐下了。

“下面，由我宣读军队党委、北京医学院党委联合下发的立功嘉奖批复。”

孙军代表从桌上拿起一个红色文件夹，翻开，声音洪亮，每个字都清清楚楚。

“经军队党委、北京医学院党委联合研究决定——授予王建新同志个人一等功，颁发一等功奖状、立功证书、喜报，全军、全市通报表彰。”

台下响起一阵掌声。不是那种稀稀拉拉的，而是整齐的、热烈的，像是排练过一样。

“职务正式提拔——由正连职军医，破格晋升为实职正营职军医，免去享受正营级待遇，定为正式正营职军队医务干部，行政级别十八级，纳入学院军队医疗骨干编制。”

掌声比刚才更响了。正营职，实职，不是“享受待遇”，是实打实的正营。王建新坐在座位上，脸上没什么表情，但手不自觉地握紧了膝盖上的裤子，心想这回工资应该涨了吧？应该比父亲高了吧？

“记入干部人事档案，作为后续职务晋升、职称评定、进修培养核心考核依据。授予‘国防战备先进个人’荣誉称号，颁发荣誉锦旗。”

“同时，参与此次防空洞挖掘及宝藏守护工作的三十三名同志，集体记集体一等功，颁发集体一等功锦旗、荣誉证书，全员全院通报表彰，授予‘战备施工模范集体’称号，全员纳入年度评优优先推荐名单，并给家乡发喜报，登报表扬，与军旗合照。”

孙军代表念完了，合上文件夹，回到座位上坐下。台下的掌声持续了好一会儿，才慢慢停下来。

接下来是先进事迹宣讲。学院革委会主任走到话筒前，手里拿着一沓稿纸，开始讲。他讲了王建新带领医疗系七班在恭王府附近挖掘防空洞的过程，讲了他们在施工中如何认真负责、一丝不苟，讲了王建新如何第一时间发现异常、第一时间停工上报、第一时间保护现场，讲了那批国家宝藏如何被完好无损地发掘出来、全数上交国家。

“王建新同志不是第一次立功了。”革委会主任翻过一页稿纸，“他在边防服役期间，就曾荣立个人一等功一次、个人三等功一次。在双桥公社开门办学期间，带领医疗队救治群众数百人。在校学习期间，完成多台高难度手术，又因救治高级首长荣立个人二等功一次。此次再立新功，是他一贯政治觉悟高、纪律观念强、奉献精神好的集中体现。”

May 29, 1971, Beijing Medical College Auditorium.

At around seven o'clock in the morning, the door of the auditorium was already full of people.Gray-blue tunic suits, grass-green military uniforms, navy blue work clothes, all kinds of clothes merged together in the morning light.Today is not a class, but a commendation meeting.The news spread a few days ago - the treasures unearthed from Prince Gong's Mansion have made a great contribution.First class merit.

Wang Jianxin came early.He was wearing a cadre military uniform with four pockets, his hat was neatly buckled on his head, his armed belt was tied tightly, and his leather shoes were so polished that he could see his silhouette.He stood at the foot of the steps at the entrance of the auditorium, looking at the crowds of people arriving one after another, with no expression on his face.Standing next to them were thirty-three other people from Class 7 of the Medical Department, all dressed neatly, with the red five-stars on their chests shining in the sun.

At eight o'clock sharp, the door to the auditorium opened.People filed in and sat in designated areas.The auditorium can seat five to six hundred people, and it was packed today.In the first few rows were the college's party and government leaders and military cadres, in the middle were faculty and staff representatives, behind were all the workers, peasants and soldiers, and on both sides sat some guests from outside the school.Sitting in the front row are two ordinary middle-aged people - the man is wearing a clean blue tunic suit, and the woman is wearing a navy blue gown, with her hair neatly combed.They are Wang Jianxin’s father and mother.

Yesterday, someone from the army came to announce that a commendation meeting would be held today and invited parents to attend.My mother ironed my father's tunic suit all night long. She filled an enamel tub with hot water and ironed the clothes back and forth to make the pleats smooth.

The conference hasn't officially started yet, and the lights on the stage are already all on.A huge portrait of a great man hangs above the rostrum, with red banners hanging on both sides - "Promote the spirit of patriotism and dedication, and commend the heroes who protect national treasures."The seats under the stage are lined up in rows, neatly arranged, like a military queue.The melody of "The East Is Red" was playing in the loudspeaker, low, like background sound.

At 8:30, leaders such as the secretary of the party committee of the college, the chief of the military stationed there, and the director of the revolutionary committee came to the podium one after another and sat down behind the long table covered with red cloth.The Party Secretary is named Li. He is in his fifties, has gray hair, wears a pair of black-rimmed glasses and a gray Mao suit.The head of the military station was named Sun. He was a military representative. He was in his early forties. He wore a military uniform and had a straight back.

Representative Sun Jun walked to the microphone and cleared his throat.

"Comrades, the commendation ceremony for workers, peasants, and soldiers of Beijing Medical College and military doctors begins now! Everyone stands up and plays and sings the national anthem!"

The prelude to "March of the Volunteers" sounded from the loudspeaker.The five to six hundred people in the audience stood up in unison. Wang Jianxin also stood up, with his back straight and his eyes looking forward.His parents also stood up. His father's posture was a bit stiff, and his mother was a little at a loss. She didn't know where to put her hands. She saw the people next to her hanging their hands on the seams of their trousers, so she followed suit.

After the national anthem was played, Representative Sun Jun asked to sit down.The chairs rumbled for a while and everyone sat down.

"Next, I will read out the approval of the meritorious service award jointly issued by the Party Committee of the Army and the Party Committee of Beijing Medical College."

Representative Sun Jun picked up a red folder from the table and opened it. His voice was loud and every word was clear.

“After a joint study and decision by the Party Committee of the Army and the Party Committee of Beijing Medical College, Comrade Wang Jianxin was awarded first-class personal merit, a first-class merit certificate, a certificate of meritorious service, and good news, and the whole army and the city announced the commendation.”

There was a burst of applause from the audience.Not that sparse, but neat and enthusiastic, as if it had been rehearsed.

"Formal promotion of position - from a company-level military doctor to a full-time battalion-level military doctor. He is exempted from the benefits of a full-time battalion level and is designated as an official battalion-level military medical cadre. The administrative level is 18th level and is included in the college's military medical backbone establishment."

The applause was louder than before.A regular job is a real job, not "enjoying perks", it is a real job.Wang Jianxin sat in his seat with no expression on his face, but his hands unconsciously clenched the pants on his knees, thinking that his salary should be increased this time, right?He should be taller than his father, right?

"Recorded in the personnel files of cadres and used as the core assessment basis for subsequent job promotion, professional title evaluation, and further training. Awarded the honorary title of 'Advanced Individual in National Defense Readiness' and issued an honorary banner."

"At the same time, the thirty-three comrades who participated in the excavation of the air-raid shelter and the protection of the treasure were collectively recorded as first-class collective merit, and were awarded first-class collective merit banners and honorary certificates. All members were commended by the whole hospital, and were awarded the title of 'Model Group for Combat Readiness Construction'. All members were included in the priority recommendation list for annual evaluations. Good news was sent to their hometown, a report of praise was published, and they took photos with the military flag."

Representative Sun Jun finished reading, closed the folder, returned to his seat and sat down.The applause from the audience lasted for a while and then slowly stopped.

Next is the presentation of advanced deeds.The director of the college's revolutionary committee walked to the microphone, holding a stack of manuscript paper in his hand, and began to speak.He talked about the process of Wang Jianxin leading Class 7 of the Medical Department to dig air-raid shelters near Prince Gong's Mansion. He talked about how they were serious, responsible and meticulous during the construction. He talked about how Wang Jianxin immediately discovered anomalies, stopped work and reported them, and protected the site as soon as possible. He also talked about how the national treasures were unearthed intact and handed over to the country.

"This is not the first time that Comrade Wang Jianxin has performed meritorious service." The director of the Revolutionary Committee turned over a page of manuscript paper. "While serving in the border defense, he was awarded first-class personal merit once and third-class personal merit once. When Shuangqiao Commune was open for school, he led the medical team to treat hundreds of people. During his studies at school, he completed many difficult operations and was awarded second-class personal merit for treating senior leaders. This new meritorious service is a concentrated expression of his consistent high political awareness, strong sense of discipline, and good dedication."
